relationships.subject: SPP1+ macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: two pro-fibrotic macrophage subpopulations, SPP1<sup>+</sup> MP and ECM-like MP, appear to facilitate ECM deposition in fibrotic deep fascia by either regulating fibroblast activation or directly contributing to ECM production

key_findings: scRNA-seq of gluteal muscle contracture fascia identifies pro-fibrotic SPP1+ macrophages
